# Aivascan

> Aivascan is an AI visibility audit service. It runs real buyer-intent
> prompts through an AI engine with live web search, records how AI
> assistants describe a business, scores the results (0–100), and delivers a
> prioritized fix plan. Operated by The Bergen Standard, LLC (New Jersey,
> USA).

Aivascan measures whether AI assistants (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity,
and Gemini) mention and recommend a business when buyers ask purchase-intent
questions — the AI-era counterpart to SEO rank tracking.

## What it does

- Free sample: 6-prompt AI visibility scan with a 2-page summary report.
  No account or credit card required. One per email and per website.
- Monthly plan ($29.99/mo): 18-prompt scan, full strategic report, competitor
  analysis, 30/60/90-day fix plan, refreshed monthly. Cancel anytime.
- Reports include an AI Visibility Score, a Site Readiness Score, the
  recorded AI answers, a competitor comparison, and copy-paste technical
  fixes (robots.txt, structured data, llms.txt, content clarity).

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://aivascan.com/): product overview, scoring, FAQ
- [Free scan](https://aivascan.com/free-scan): run a free sample report
- [Pricing](https://aivascan.com/pricing): plans and billing terms
- [AI visibility vs SEO](https://aivascan.com/ai-visibility-vs-seo): guide to
  how AI-assistant visibility differs from search rankings
- [Contact](https://aivascan.com/contact): team@aivascan.com

## Who it's for

Small and medium businesses, marketing leads, and agencies whose customers
research purchases through AI assistants — local services, professional
services, SaaS, e-commerce, healthcare, law firms, consulting.
